articles.summary: Nerdy Inc. (NYSE: NRDY) today announced that Chairman, Founder and CEO Chuck Cohn purchased $4.4 million or 3.5 million shares of Nerdy common stock at an average price of $1.24 in the open market during the fourth quarter of 2025. With this purchase, Mr. Cohn owns 91.4 million shares of Nerdy common stock as of December 31, 2025. The fourth quarter open market purchases were made between November 19, 2025 and December 16, 2025, the details of which are reflected in the Form 4s filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Since becoming a public company in September 2021, Mr. Cohn has purchased $81.0 million of Nerdy common stock, representing approximately 51.4 million shares. About Nerdy Inc. Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) is a leading platform for live online learning, with a mission to transform the way people learn through technology.
